title: Gaussian bad-tail logarithmic rate
statement: Let $0<\rho<1$, let $Q(t)=\mathbb{P}(Z>t)$ for a standard normal random variable $Z$, and set $B_\rho(t)=Q((t-1)/\rho)$. As $t\to+\infty$, $\frac{\log B_\rho(t)}{t^2}$ tends to $-\frac{1}{2\rho^2}$.
